summary: San Francisco Bay Area, software developer, experience in web-based technology and programming (Node.js, JavaScript), strong preference for open-source software (GIMP, Inkscape), critical of corporate practices (especially regarding Google and Facebook), interest in cross-platform development, advocate for privacy and free speech, former fat guy, enjoys Japanese food, has a network drive for personal data storage, critical of social media algorithms, believes in the importance of physical health and exercise, skeptical of traditional education systems, prefers Markdown for writing, has a technical background in software engineering, engaged in discussions about political and social issues, values local elections over national ones, has a critical view of democracy and its effectiveness, enjoys historical dramas (e.g., "Rome"), has a hobbyist interest in game development and programming, prefers using private servers for email and data storage, has a nuanced view on dietary health and nutrition.
